articles.headline: Arizona star Koa Peat to remain in NBA draft
articles.description: Arizona forward Koa Peat, a projected first-round pick, is keeping his name in the NBA draft.

images.caption: Koa Peat starts this sweet 16 match off with an impressive dunk.

articles.headline: Vanderbilt PG Tyler Tanner withdraws from NBA draft
articles.description: Vanderbilt's Tyler Tanner, one of the elite point guards in the country, told ESPN on Wednesday that he has withdrawn from the NBA draft and will return for his junior season.

articles.headline: Milan Momcilovic withdraws from NBA draft, set for college return
articles.description: Former Iowa State forward Milan Momcilovic, the No. 1 player in the transfer portal, is withdrawing from the NBA draft and will play college basketball next season, his agents told ESPN.

images.caption: Milan Momcilovic went on a 9-0 run for Iowa State to end the half.

article.story: COLLEGE STATION, Texas -- — Rashaun Agee scored a season-high 21 points and grabbed eight rebounds as Texas A&M rolled past East Texas A&M 118-77 on Sunday with the third-highest point total in program history. The 118-point total isn't even the largest for the Aggies this season. They defeated Mississippi Valley State 120-84 on Nov. 25, the most points ever scored in Reed Arena. They have scored 100-plus points in five games this season. Pop Isaacs added 15 points, Marcus Hill 13 and Mackenzie Mgbako 12 for the Aggies (9-3), who shot 65% and made half of their 28 3-point attempts. Mgbako added nine rebounds. Ronnie Harrison matched a season high with 23 points to lead the Lions (6-6), who shot 35%. Agee scored the Aggies' first eight points and Texas A&M led thereafter with the lead remaining in double figures after Jacari Lane hit a 3 and Isaacs followed with two more 3s for an 18-point lead midway through the half. The lead grew to 31 before the Lions outscored the Aggies 18-8 over the final five minutes to trail 56-36 at the break. The Aggies' lead remained comfortably in double figures in the second half, reaching a high of 44 late. Up next East Texas A&M is home against Stephen F. Austin on Dec. 29. Texas A&M is home against Prairie View on Dec. 29. ------ Get poll alerts and updates on the AP Top 25 throughout the season. Sign up here and here (AP News mobile app).
